title: RSI: Sharing accepted versions
question: After merge, should participating machines update automatically, on startup, or only when you request it?

origin.title: RSI: Sharing accepted versions

history.reason: Capture an unresolved choice from the agent proposal before the owner first pass; alignment only.

proposal.readback:
**Question:** After merge, should participating machines update automatically, on startup, or only when you request it?

**Recommended answer:** Offer an explicit enrollment policy for checked updates between uses, with pinned versions for active work, preservation of local edits and a rollback path. Record installed and actually loaded versions. Choose the update timing and enrollment scope with you.

**Why:** I assumed a distribution policy without your direction. Merging shared source does not make a repaired version available in every environment.

**Intended impact:** Determines how improvements reach your work and how later use can establish whether the repair held.
